title: Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A slow-cooked North African stew originating from Tunisia, typically made with lamb and a blend of spices. This recipe combines the flavors of the region with the richness of lamb.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pot and set aside. Add onion and garlic to pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add tunisian spice blend, smoky paprika, salt, and black pepper to pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add lamb back to pot, along with apricots, chicken broth, and tagine.
Bring mixture to a boil, then cover and transfer to oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Serve lamb and sauce over couscous or rice.
